description: This file is a header file for the implementation of the MD5 message-digest algorithm, defining data structures, macros, and function prototypes related to MD5.

classes.name: MD5_CTX
classes.description: Data structure for MD5 (Message-Digest) computation, holding state information such as counters, buffers, input, and digest.

methods.name: MD5_Init
methods.description: Initializes MD5 context for a new hash computation.

methods.name: MD5_Update
methods.description: Updates MD5 context with new data to be hashed.

methods.name: MD5_Final
methods.description: Completes the MD5 hash computation and produces the final digest.
